entities.name: Kharkiv National Medical University
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Kharkiv National Medical University, formerly known as Kharkiv Medical Institute and Kharkiv State Medical University, is a State-sponsored medical university in Kharkiv, Ukraine. In March 2022 many buildings were heavily damaged due to the Russian invasion into Ukraine.
